meta.description: Automated pipeline translating complex Blender Cycles scenes into high-performance Three.js WebGL with sub-pixel visual parity, AgX tone mapping, and Draco geometry compression.

showcases.label: Bender Grand Finale
showcases.summary: 46-joint rig, -145° horizontal door swing, 14 synchronized actions, thin-film soap bubbles, 3D text wordplay marquee.

bullets.text: 46-joint armature with 100% rigid component bone weighting, zero mesh tearing, vertical Y-hinge door swing.
41 PBR materials: thin-film iridescence, Cauchy dispersion glass, viscous goo volume absorption, titanium unibody.
14 synchronized animation tracks (135-channel Bender choreography, crate lid unlatch, 6 parabolic fountain arcs).
9.3m background 3D title 'Blender2Three.js' with the letter 'l' in radiant amber/gold revealing the 'Bender' inside.

showcases.challenge: One shot combines 52 objects, 41 layered Principled materials, 14 animation tracks, dispersion glass and thin-film bubbles. The stock exporter flattens the material graph and drops the volume and iridescence extensions.

showcases.label: Optical Glass & Volume
showcases.summary: Physical glass transmission with volume absorption distance, attenuation color, Cauchy dispersion, and high-frequency caustics.

bullets.text: KHR_materials_transmission (transmission: 0.98, roughness: 0.02, IOR: 1.52) with background refraction pass.
KHR_materials_volume attenuation color (#06b6d4) with physical thicknessFactor and absorption falloff.
Simulated spectral chromatic aberration across faceted crystal geometry.
Sub-pixel specular highlight roll-off matching Cycles AgX base contrast.

showcases.challenge: Cycles glass is a surface plus a volume: thickness, attenuation and dispersion all matter. glTF transmission alone keeps none of the volume, so the material has to be patched after export.

showcases.label: Advanced PBR & Mirrors
showcases.summary: Multi-layer clearcoat, microfiber sheen scattering, emissive strength scaling, and real-time CubeCamera reflections.

bullets.text: Dual-layer automotive lacquer clearcoat (clearcoat: 1.0, clearcoatRoughness: 0.04) over metallic flake.
Charlie sheen BRDF for velvet microfiber rim lighting and grazing-angle backscattering.
Real-time 6-sided CubeCamera reflection probes capturing inter-object specular bounces.
KHR_materials_emissive_strength for HDR radiance without tone-mapping wash.

showcases.challenge: Clearcoat, sheen and true mirror reflections have no single glTF material. Reflections must be driven by probes, and the layered BSDFs have to be rebuilt without flattening them.

showcases.label: Punctual Lights & Shadows
showcases.summary: KHR_lights_punctual translation with accurate spot cone angle, spot blend falloff, and PCF soft shadow cascades.

bullets.text: Exact cone angle and blend translation matching Blender's spot_size and spot_blend.
Physical quadratic distance decay with lumen-to-candela power calibration.
PCFSoftShadowMap with calibrated shadow bias eliminating shadow acne and peter-panning.
Studio 3-point key, fill, and rim rig with color-managed spectral temperature.

showcases.challenge: Blender spotlights export as punctual lights with different falloff and shadow behaviour. Matching cone edges, inverse-square decay and soft shadows is the work.

showcases.label: Procedural Shader Baking
showcases.summary: Bakes procedural Voronoi, Noise, and Musgrave nodes into channel-packed ORM PBR maps and tangent normal maps.

bullets.text: Automated headless 4-pass Cycles bake (BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic, Normal).
Packed ORM image maps (Red = AO, Green = Roughness, Blue = Metalness) saving 66% texture bandwidth.
High-precision tangent space normal map derived from procedural 3D heightfields.
Automatic smart UV projection ensuring non-overlapping texel density.

showcases.challenge: Voronoi, Noise and Musgrave shaders do not exist in glTF. They must be baked into ORM and tangent-normal maps without losing texel density.

showcases.label: Rigging, Skinning & Gyro
showcases.summary: Multi-bone armature skinning, glTF shape key morph targets, and nested multi-axis gyro rotational hierarchies.

bullets.text: Linear blend skinning with normalized vertex group weights and bone transform matrices.
glTF morph target position/normal deltas with animated track channels.
Nested 3-axis gimbal ring rotation preserving Euler rotation order and zero gimbal lock.
Precise frame seeking and seamless looping in Three.js runtime.

showcases.challenge: Armature skinning, morph targets and nested gyro hierarchies have to survive Draco while keeping bone rolls and clip timing intact.

showcases.label: Iridescence Soap Bubbles
showcases.summary: Thin-film wave interference diffraction creating rainbow color fringes on soap bubbles and brushed metallic anisotropy.

bullets.text: KHR_materials_iridescence (thickness: 100-480nm, IOR: 1.33) producing physical color diffraction.
KHR_materials_anisotropy for elongated specular highlights on brushed stainless steel.
Ultra-thin dielectric membrane with 98% transmission and zero shadow occlusion.
Secondary reflection layer augmenting iridescent film depth.

showcases.challenge: Thin-film interference is a shader effect, not a texture. The glTF iridescence extension approximates it, and the film collapses without an environment to reflect.

showcases.label: Alpha Foliage & Decals
showcases.summary: Alpha test cutoff masking, double-sided depth sorting, custom shadow depth materials, and decal polygon offsetting.

bullets.text: alphaMode MASK with calibrated alphaCutoff (0.5) preventing sorting artifacts.
customDepthMaterial with alpha discard enabling leaves to cast realistic perforated shadows.
PolygonOffset material parameters preventing z-fighting on floor decals.
Double-sided normal orientation matching Cycles two-sided leaf rendering.

showcases.challenge: Alpha-tested leaves need cutout shadows and deterministic sort order. Alpha blending here produces halos, and the leaf cutouts have to cast perforated shadows.

showcases.label: GPU Instancing Array
showcases.summary: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing collapses 180 linked hexagonal pillars into 1 single draw call with per-instance TRS buffers.

bullets.text: 180 individual mesh objects collapsed into 1 single WebGL draw call (180:1 ratio).
Packed TRANSLATION, ROTATION, and SCALE attribute buffers compressed with Draco.
Full instanced shadow cascades rendered efficiently in a single shadow pass.
60 FPS steady performance even on low-power mobile GPUs.

showcases.challenge: 180 linked pillars must leave the exporter as one instanced draw call. The exporter's GPU instancing flag is conditional, and enabling it on the wrong scene breaks export.

showcases.label: Multi-Material Cyber Deck
showcases.summary: Partitioned multi-material primitives sharing dual UV sets (TEXCOORD_0 for PBR, TEXCOORD_1 for Lightmap/AO) across Draco.

bullets.text: Single master mesh partitioned into 4 discrete material primitives without vertex duplication.
Preservation of TEXCOORD_0 and TEXCOORD_1 across Draco compression for secondary aoMap channel.
Transmissive glass visor castShadow set to false, allowing screen emission to pass unobstructed.
Backlit buttons and HUD visor emitting sharp, un-clipped glow.

showcases.challenge: One mesh carries four material primitives and two UV sets. The exporter can split, merge or drop TEXCOORD_1 through Draco.

showcases.label: Sentinel Tower LOD
showcases.summary: 3-tier distance LOD hierarchy (11.1k → 2.7k → 538 tris) with EXT_meshopt_compression and automatic runtime switching.

bullets.text: Seamless distance thresholds (0m → 10m → 20m) with automatic triangle decimation.
EXT_meshopt_compression integrated with MeshoptDecoder for fast, parallel GPU unpacking.
LOD containers properly assembled from multi-material groups without parent detachment bugs.
Round plasma dome and cooling fin silhouettes preserved across all view distances.

showcases.challenge: Three LOD tiers must survive compression and still assemble by node name. A multi-primitive LOD loads as a Group, not a Mesh, so the assembly silently never happens.

showcases.label: Gothic Sacred Relic Shrine
showcases.summary: 48-step screen-space raymarching volume with Henyey-Greenstein Mie scattering and analytical window mullion shadow slicing.

bullets.text: 48-step volumetric box raymarcher with screen-space dither noise preventing color banding.
Physical Henyey-Greenstein Mie forward scattering (g=0.35) matching Cycles atmospheric fog.
Analytical shadow projection for 5 vertical iron mullion window bars at X=-6.5.
Cinematic Gothic mood calibrated with 0.75 AgX exposure and 0.12 ambient floor bounce.

showcases.challenge: Volumetric raymarching does not exist in glTF. The fog has to be reconstructed in the viewer while the geometry stays lit through the same window bars.

showcases.label: Articulated Mecha Sentinel
showcases.summary: Rigged bipedal combatant with 100% rigid component bone weighting and actionsMap crossfading preventing superposition bleeding.

bullets.text: Pre-assigned 100% bone weights to component plates, preventing head visor ripping and vertex bleeding.
Dedicated actions registry isolating Idle, Walk, and Strike clips with smooth 0.35s crossfading.
Blender Z-up armature transformed into Three.js Y-up joints with verified bone roll.
All 11 joints and 3 animation clips preserved through Draco compression with 78.3% size reduction.

showcases.challenge: Mechanical parts need 100% rigid bone weights. Any interpolation tears the visor or bleeds weights across the plates.

showcases.label: Magnetic Containment Chamber
showcases.summary: Physical hollow open-tube containment shield, 4-key morph target delta retention, and radiant bioluminescent core.

bullets.text: 4 concurrent morph target delta streams (Squash, Stretch, Wobble1, Wobble2) preserved across Draco.
Physical open cylinder eliminating flat-cap endcap z-fighting and shadow occlusion.
Viscous goo absorption (density: 0.75, IOR: 1.38, transmission: 0.88) with glowing radioactive nuclei.
Induction copper coils and dark titanium alloy base/cap flanges.

showcases.challenge: Viscous volume absorption and four morph streams share an open-tube glass shell. The material and the morph targets both have to survive compression.

showcases.label: CYBER — Neon City
showcases.summary: 143 meshes, 20 punctual lights and 8 emissive clusters. The four text signs must become geometry, and the neon wash is emission, not a light — glTF has no way to bounce it.
showcases.challenge: 143 meshes, 20 punctual lights and 8 emissive clusters. The four text signs must become geometry, and the neon wash is emission, not a light — glTF has no way to bounce it.

bullets.text: FONT objects converted to meshes so the four signs survive export.
Pure emission nodes rebuilt as Principled BSDF with emission strength.
Bare meshes assigned PBR; fallback ambient/directional lights removed; shadow acne fixed.
Physical hemisphere GI bounce and exposure 0.94 matched to the Cycles reference.

showcases.label: 3D Hologram
showcases.summary: Seven concentric gimbal rings and one glass sphere, with no authored light source. The stock exporter emits empty material stubs, and the emissive core has to light itself.
showcases.challenge: Seven concentric gimbal rings and one glass sphere, with no authored light source. The stock exporter emits empty material stubs, and the emissive core has to light itself.

bullets.text: AgX background calibrated from #0a0c12 to #1a1a1b.
shadow.normalBias tuned to remove polygon acne on the rings.
Holographic torus cores boosted so the emissive geometry reads as the light source.

showcases.label: Mustang Fastback
showcases.summary: Automotive clearcoat over metallic flake, lit by seven studio softboxes. Area lights export as hard spots, and the clearcoat response has no direct glTF equivalent.
showcases.challenge: Automotive clearcoat over metallic flake, lit by seven studio softboxes. Area lights export as hard spots, and the clearcoat response has no direct glTF equivalent.

bullets.text: Seven studio softboxes replaced with directional proxies; area-light falloff approximated.
MeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat over metallic flake.
Dark maroon AgX fill matched to the infinity drape.

showcases.label: Storm Water Passage
showcases.summary: A concrete tunnel with daylight shafts: 52 meshes, 5 lights and 24 error clusters. The hard parts are area-light falloff and the sky bounce inside the cavities.
showcases.challenge: A concrete tunnel with daylight shafts: 52 meshes, 5 lights and 24 error clusters. The hard parts are area-light falloff and the sky bounce inside the cavities.

bullets.text: Spot angle widened to 170 degrees and shadow normalBias calibrated.
Hemisphere fill added to recover the sky bounce inside the tunnel.

showcases.label: Alien Animal
showcases.summary: The base albedo texture is missing from the source, so the Cycles reference renders empty; the comparison is against that empty reference. The pipeline still translates the creature geometry, the packed chitin maps and the sun/spot lighting.
showcases.challenge: The base albedo texture is missing from the source, so the Cycles reference renders empty; the comparison is against that empty reference. The pipeline still translates the creature geometry, the packed chitin maps and the sun/spot lighting.

bullets.text: The missing base texture leaves the Cycles reference empty; the heatmap shows the geometry against that empty frame.
Sun and spot intensities and shadow bias calibrated; ambient fill lifts the cavity shadows.
Background calibrated to the Cycles AgX world (#39393a).

showcases.label: Quantum Computer
showcases.summary: A dilution refrigerator with a glass casing and gold wiring tiers. The glass casing casts a fully opaque shadow over the interior, and the wire grid is easy to lose in the reflection.
showcases.challenge: A dilution refrigerator with a glass casing and gold wiring tiers. The glass casing casts a fully opaque shadow over the interior, and the wire grid is easy to lose in the reflection.

bullets.text: Glass casing no longer casts opaque shadows; spot bias and normalBias calibrated.
Room-environment IBL at 0.26 intensity restores the gold wiring reflections.
Cool-sky / warm-ground hemisphere fill recovers the interior bounce.
63.3 MB raw glTF to 3.12 MB delivered (95.1% reduction).
